comment: The enum declares four outputs named Dummy ahead of the three real ones. CD4063.cpp adds no widget for them and never writes to them, so indexes 0 to 3 have no jack on the panel. CD4063.cpp:136 also reads the A=B cascade jack through the gtInput object rather than the unused eqInput one, so the A=B and A>B cascade jacks share a single Schmitt trigger state within a sample. With clean logic levels the result is the same, but a voltage between 0.1V and 2V on either jack can carry the wrong state to the other.
